name: ppt-master
tagline_zh: 别再为改PPT熬夜，从空白到可编辑成品，还能套用你的品牌模板，甚至给旧PPT整容。一键生成，细节不丢。
tagline_en: Stop wrestling with slides. Generate editable decks, reuse your brand templates, or refresh old PPTs—all in one.
desc_en: AI-driven presentation workflow for generating editable PPTX decks, creating reusable Brand/Style/Layout/Deck workspaces, filling native PPTX templates, and enhancing finished PPTX files. Use when the user asks to create, regenerate, template, fill, or enhance a presentation, or mentions ppt-master.
why_zh: 它不只是生成，而是把品牌、版式、模板变成可复用工作区，连旧文件都能直接增强，这是别家没有的。
why_en: Unlike one-shot generators, it turns your brand and layouts into reusable workspaces and even enhances existing PPTX files.
